commit_message:
Hide non system overlay window immediately if it is animating exit

Otherwise, WSA#applyAnimationLocked skips the hide animation and
the hide operation will wait for the previous exit animation to be
finished, which could be a long duration.

Bug: 463364410
Flag: EXEMPT BUGFIX
Test: Remove a window with a long exit duration animation.
      Launch an activity with using hide-overlay flag.
      The removing window should be hidden immediately.
